dx_startup.description: dx binary startup latency (direct `dx --help`, no Bazel server). First generous absolute gate; a blown budget is unambiguous.

dx_status.description: dx status report latency (direct binary, no scope query). Advisory until months of stable signal.

dx_status_json.description: dx status JSON rendering latency (machine-output contract). Advisory.

generate_check_cold.description: generate --check cold on reference fixture (after `bazel shutdown`, includes server startup + analysis). Main + dispatch only; advisory.
generate_check_cold.reference: bench_cold: bazel shutdown then full `bazel run //dx/cli:dx -- generate --check` stack, single timing

generate_check_warm.description: generate --check warm on reference fixture (Bazel server warm, actions cached). Advisory.

scope_deps.description: scope resolution via `dx deps` (Bazel query). Advisory.

scope_owners.description: scope resolution via `dx owners` (file-scope Bazel query). Advisory; floor 100ms covers observed run-to-run median spread (~85ms) on the seed host.

calibration.budgets: provisional generous absolutes set above 3x main noise; never guessed. Relative comparison stays advisory until months of stable signal, then promote per-benchmark.
calibration.host: linux_x86_64 seed host, local execution, no remote
calibration.method: perf/bench.sh harness (EPOCHREALTIME bracketing, direct dx binary except cold via full bazel-run stack); micro median-of-7, scenario median-of-5, cold single-timing after `bazel shutdown`; 3x main runs combined (21 micro samples, 15 scenario samples, 3 cold samples)

policy.baseline_updates: human-merged PRs only; no bot commits (per repo automation policy). To recalibrate: run `bazel run //perf:bench_all` 3x on main, update baseline_ms via PR with evidence, regenerate docs via `bazel run //perf:regenerate`.
policy.comparison: per-PR runs compare median-of-N against baseline with tolerance band (relative + absolute floor against runner noise); regressions post a warn-only PR comment. Relative comparison stays advisory; only `gate:true` budgets fail (currently dx_startup only).
policy.no_command_surface: No `dx perf` command — Bazel targets plus docs (ADR 0006 minimal surface).
policy.tolerance: regression iff median > baseline*(1+tolerance_relative) AND median-baseline > floor_ms
